text:
Nina: quick heads-up: CI found duplicate webhook deliveries from onboarding sampleapp when auth rotated during a 429 spike. repro attached.
Omar: bummer. sounds like retries lost the original idempotency hint. sampleapp was calling SDK without an Idempotency-Key.
Priya: can we make SDK inject an Idempotency-Key by default for mutating non-stream RPCs? keep opt-out.
Nina: also swap to full-jitter backoff; current exponential+no-jitter syncs retries.
Omar: agree on defaults: maxRetries=3, base=120ms, cap=1.2s, strategy=full-jitter.
Priya: will add Node util and Python parity. testing: unit that simulates 429 during token refresh and assert server sees same key.
Nina: add metrics: auto_idempotency_used, duplicate_side_effects. ops wants alerting when duplicates spike.
ci-bot: created job `ci/onboarding/idempotency-429` (weekly).
Omar: will PR Node today. Priya picks Python. Nina will update onboarding docs and sampleapp.
Priya: one nuance: do NOT auto-insert for streaming/chunked requests.
Nina: correct. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
